name: meeting-transcribe-agent
title_zh: 会议录完自动出逐字稿，连幻灯片和说话人一起认
tagline_zh: 开完会不想再听一遍录音？丢进 YouTube 链接或本地视频，它逐句转写、认出每页幻灯片和谁在说话。
tagline_en: Drop a YouTube link or local video: it transcribes line by line, reads the slides, labels who spoke, and.
desc_en: Universal meeting intelligence and interactive verbatim transcription suite adhering to Agent Skills Specification. Features native Multimodal Video Pipeline (YouTube URLs & local video files with visual slide/speaker OCR and optional Agentic Video Understanding), Google Gemini 3.5 Transcribe (cloud primary audio with ephemeral Files API auto-cleanup), and local Apple Silicon MLX/Whisper + Sherpa-
why_zh: 视频、音频、幻灯片三条线一起走，不是先转文字再补画面；云端主用 Gemini 转写。
why_en: Video, audio and slides are processed together rather than text-first; cloud transcription uses Gemini with ephemeral Files API.
limit_zh: 本地离线那条路只认 Apple Silicon 的 Mac，Intel 机器和 Windows 只能走云端。
limit_en: Local offline mode requires an Apple Silicon Mac (Intel/Windows must use cloud); cloud needs your own Gemini API key and has upload size/duration.
title_en: Meeting recordings become verbatim transcripts with slides.
